issue_title: WindowCount widget does not update on togroup() without switch_group
issue_body:
### Issue description

I use keybindings for calling `lazy.window.togroup(name)` (without `switch_group=True`) and I noticed that the WindowCount widget does not update until I change group or spawn/close a window in the current group.

A fix is to subscribe to the `group_window_add` hook in the WindowCount widget. I will prepare a PR.



### Version

0.26.1.dev0+ge4b4bb8b.d20240523

### Backend

X11 (default)
